::: session-meta
| | |
|---|---|
| **When** | 29 September 2026, 15:00–17:00 |
| **Where** | Maastricht University — location TBC |
| **For whom** | Researchers and students of Maastricht University |

**Speaker:** Prof. Dr. Wolfgang Viechtbauer — Associate Professor of Methodology and Statistics, Department of Psychiatry, Faculty of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences, Maastricht University.

R is one of the most widely used programming languages and open-source environments for statistical computing and data visualisation. It is applied across a broad range of research fields including the social sciences, economics, psychology, epidemiology, and bioinformatics.
